thread.title: SPY, GNMA: Big ETF Inflows

author: BNK Invest
title: SPY, GNMA: Big ETF Inflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the SPDR S&P 500 ETF ( SPY ), which added 20,900,000 units, or a 2.2% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of SPY, in morning trading today Microsoft Corporation ( MSFT ) is up about 3.9%, and Apple ( AAPL ) is up by about 3.3%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the iShares GNMA Bond ETF ( GNMA ), which added 800,000 units, for a 37.2% increase in outstanding units.
